summary: Data professional with 3+ years building production pipelines, validation frameworks and analytical products across enterprise environments. Strong Python, SQL and cloud-data foundation with hands-on experience in orchestration, modelling and dashboard delivery. Bias toward reliable systems, concise documentation and evidence that survives operational use.

skills.items: Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Fabric, Snowflake, PostgreSQL and Delta Lake
Python, SQL, PySpark, pandas, NumPy, Bash and Git
ETL/ELT, batch ingestion, schema validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection and monitoring
forecasting, regression, classification, statistical testing and model evaluation
CI/CD, automated testing, Power BI, Streamlit, documentation and stakeholder communication

bullets: Own production data pipelines integrating ERP, SFTP, REST API and third-party feeds into governed lakehouse layers.
Deliver a warehouse migration across more than one hundred tables with reconciliation, parallel-run validation and performance tuning.
Led root cause investigation on a multi-week silent ingestion failure and redesigned source-count checks to detect schema drift on arrival.
Partner with finance, BI and engineering teams to translate operational requirements into tested data products.
Model curated reporting layers for operational and executive users, documenting ownership, refresh expectations and upstream dependencies.
Maintain incident notes and controlled handovers so recurring jobs can be supported without relying on undocumented personal knowledge.
Build Power BI reporting layers over curated datasets for operational and executive users, with validation checks aligned to source-system totals.
Prototype unproven technical approaches in small, reviewable increments before introducing them into recurring production work.
Built reproducible statistical validation workflows with calibration checks, truth tables and auditable documentation.
Applied comparative analytical methods to identify pathways across a public-service dataset and translated the findings into concise evidence for programme leads.
Maintained reproducible scripts, versioned inputs and review notes so analytical outputs could be audited and rerun by another researcher.
Prepared structured comparison tables and concise presentation material for an interdisciplinary audience.
Integrated Python and SQL with an enterprise ERP platform, improving data-quality reliability and supporting stakeholder validation through dashboards.
Built validation dashboards for business review and maintained pull-request checks across a cross-functional delivery team.
Worked with business users to reconcile source counts and agree acceptance checks before release.
Documented transformation logic and source-to-target mappings for controlled production handover.
Built and evaluated computer-vision inference pipelines in Python, then deployed repeatable services with containers on cloud infrastructure.
Automated evaluation against stable benchmarks and documented deployment, monitoring and rollback procedures for each release.
Delivered standardised reporting across national programmes and reduced recurring turnaround through reusable data models.
Coordinated reporting requirements with programme owners and trained contributors to use shared definitions and templates consistently.
